whatIs: Copywriting is writing whose job is to make someone act — click, enquire, add to cart, reply — while content writing is writing whose job is to inform and build trust over time, such as articles, guides and FAQs. Both need the same things: a clear understanding of the buyer, a specific promise, and language plain enough to be quoted.

gaa-tha writes both from a single brand voice document, so a product bullet on Amazon, a Meta ad, a reel script and a blog answer all sound like the same company. Every piece is written answer-first and entity-rich so it reads well to a buyer, ranks on Google, and can be cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity — the same approach we use on gaa-tha.com.
included: Website and landing-page copy: home, services, about, product and campaign pages
Product titles, bullets and descriptions for Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify and quick commerce, including 200+ SKU catalogues
Ad copy variations for Meta, Google and WhatsApp campaigns
Reel, video and cinema ad scripts with hooks and CTAs
Blog articles, guides and FAQ pages written for SEO, AEO and GEO
B2B and export sales copy: email sequences, IndiaMART listings, LinkedIn posts
Tone of voice document and messaging pillars
Hindi and Gujarati versions and transcreation

steps.title: Voice and audience
steps.text: We read what you already have, interview the founders or sales team, and write a short tone of voice and messaging document everyone works from.

steps.title: Research
steps.text: For each piece we gather product facts, customer questions, competitor language and search terms, so the writing is specific rather than generic.

steps.title: Write
steps.text: First drafts are written answer-first, with headlines, hooks and CTAs, and structured for the channel — a listing, a landing page, a script or an article.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Two rounds of revisions with your team; facts, claims and mandatory text are checked, and product data is reconciled to your master sheet.

steps.title: Publish and measure
steps.text: Copy is handed over in the format each platform needs, or uploaded by our teams, and we watch rankings, click-through and conversion to refine it.

deliverables: Tone of voice and messaging document
Final copy in Google Docs, or a structured sheet for bulk listings
Ad copy sets with variations labelled for testing
Scripts with shot notes for reels and films
SEO/AEO-ready articles with titles, meta descriptions and FAQ blocks
Translations or transcreations in Hindi and Gujarati
pricing: Per-piece or per-project fee for websites, catalogues and scripts, or a monthly content retainer for brands that need listings, ads and articles every month; volumes and languages set the scope.

faq.q: What is the difference between copywriting and content writing?
faq.a: Copywriting persuades: ads, landing pages, product listings, emails, scripts. Content writing informs and builds trust: articles, guides, FAQs, case studies. Most brands need both, and gaa-tha writes both from the same tone of voice document so the brand sounds consistent.

faq.q: Can you write product listings for hundreds of SKUs?
faq.a: Yes. We work from your master product sheet, write titles, bullets and descriptions to each marketplace's character limits and keyword needs, and deliver them in a bulk-upload-ready sheet. Catalogues of 200 or more SKUs are handled in weekly batches with a style guide so every listing reads the same.

faq.q: Do you write for SEO and AI search?
faq.a: Yes. Every article, service page and FAQ is written answer-first, with clear headings, named entities and structured data in mind, so it ranks on Google and can be cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Our SEO, AEO and GEO team sets the keywords and questions; the writers make the answers worth quoting.

faq.q: Do you use AI to write?
faq.a: We use AI tools for research, outlines, variations and first-pass translation, and human writers for the thinking, the facts, the voice and the final draft. Nothing is published without a person checking claims, tone and accuracy, and copy is never left sounding generic.

faq.q: Can you write in Hindi and Gujarati?
faq.a: Yes. We write and transcreate in Hindi and Gujarati for ads, packaging, reels and WhatsApp campaigns, with native speakers reviewing each version, which matters for brands selling in Gujarat and across tier-2 India.

faq.q: How long does website copy take?
faq.a: One to three weeks for a corporate or D2C site, depending on the number of pages and how quickly interviews and approvals happen. Individual pieces such as an ad set, a script or an article take two to five days.

faq.q: What do you need from us to start?
faq.a: Your existing website and materials, product data, a short conversation with the founder or sales lead about customers and objections, brand guidelines if they exist, and a list of the pieces you need first. From that we write the voice document and start drafting.

faq.q: Do you write B2B and export sales copy?
faq.a: Yes. Company profiles, IndiaMART and Alibaba listings, cold email sequences, LinkedIn posts and export brochures for manufacturers and exporters are a regular part of the work, written to answer a procurement buyer's questions — capacity, certifications, MOQ, lead time — plainly.
